story.prose: In the village of Nyzhni Mlyny, amidst a willow grove and a quiet pond with swans, a whole world has been built for those who are tired of the city. A two-story restaurant in an old fairy-tale style, a hotel in the middle of nature, a wood-fired bathhouse with Carpathian herbs, and an outdoor water park are all in one place.
story.pull_quote: "Three summer playgrounds on the water, surrounded by fountains and swans - this is where real relaxation begins."

reviews.r1_text: We came back for the third time. Hotel, restaurant, water park - everything is on the same level. Special thanks to the chef for the duck with apples and the staff who remembered us from our last visit.
reviews.r2_text: We celebrated our wedding anniversary. The suite overlooking the pond, dinner on the terrace, and a wood-fired sauna were unforgettable. We came here from Kharkiv and didn't regret a second of it.
reviews.r3_text: We held a corporate event for 40 people. The banquet hall, animation, brewery with tasting - everything was done without a single hitch. The team was perfectly organized.
reviews.r4_text: We came with our children (3 and 7 years old) for the winter vacation. The water park was open, the restaurant had a children's menu, and the hotel had a warm family room. The kids are delighted, we had a great time.
reviews.r5_text: The wood-fired bath with Carpathian herbs is a separate song. I have not had such a deep rest for a long time. The tea room with a samovar is a highlight. We will definitely come back again.

hero.title: Sauna + Hot Tub
hero.subtitle: A source of health in the forest.
hero.subtitle2: Two wood-fired saunas. Open-air Carpathian hot tubs.

intro.title: A source of health
intro.body: The sauna is a unique place where everyone can find a source of health and relaxation to their taste. On the grounds of the Glukhoman restaurant and hotel complex, nestled by the forest, stand two wood-fired saunas with open-air Carpathian hot tubs: the Small Sauna and the Large Sauna, where you can enjoy all the benefits and traditions of wellness treatments: various massages, scrubs, wraps, Carpathian and citrus hot tubs.
intro.slider_1_alt: Small sauna — exterior view among the trees

mala.title: Small sauna
mala.body: The pool in the Small Sauna is located outdoors.
mala.photo_1_alt: Small sauna — wooden log cabin, red roof
mala.photo_2_alt: Outdoor pool and plunge pool at the Small Sauna
mala.photo_3_alt: Small sauna rest room with samovar
mala.photo_4_alt: Stone terrace in front of the hot tub among the trees

velyka.title: Large sauna
velyka.body: The pool in the Large Sauna is located indoors.
velyka.photo_1_alt: Open-air Carpathian hot tub at the Large Sauna
velyka.photo_2_alt: Rest room with foliage and leather sofa
velyka.photo_4_alt: Rest room with samovar in the Large Sauna

prices.title: Sauna rental — 1000 UAH/hour
prices.body: How is a wood-fired sauna built? First of all, authentic saunas are made entirely of wood, except for the stone stove. The Glukhoman sauna is lined with linden and fitted with several shelves made from linden. The temperature in the steam room reaches 90–100 °C.
prices.staff_note: Our administrators are always at your service to help organise your stay at the highest level. The services of a bath attendant and certified massage therapist are available by advance booking — they will help you relax to the fullest and enjoy every treatment.

oak.title: Brooms in the steam room
oak.body_p1: Steaming with brooms improves blood circulation, cleanses the skin and removes toxins, relaxes muscles and strengthens immunity. During the procedure, the soaked broom releases essential oils and phytoncides that nourish the skin and have antibacterial properties.
oak.body_p2: Because of the high steam content in the air, the body heats up much more intensely than in a dry sauna: sweat does not evaporate, and thanks to increased blood circulation the internal tissues begin to warm through. After heating up, the body naturally craves cooling in the cold-water pool, until the urge to warm up returns — and so it goes, several rounds from heat to cold and back. Excellent tempering for the body and a great workout for the blood vessels!
oak.photo_1_alt: Oak broom massage in the steam room
oak.photo_3_alt: Cooling down in the pool after the steam room

carpathian.title: Carpathian hot tub
carpathian.body: The "Carpathian hot tub" add-on is a unique spa treatment. It helps to forget about stress and stimulates the cardiovascular system and kidneys. The treatments can relieve pain from rheumatism, normalise metabolism and reduce the risk of colds. The healing warmth of the hot water penetrates every cell of the body, deeply relaxes the muscles and gives them genuine rest, delivering incomparable benefits. Water temperature in the tub: 38–40 °C. Infused with medicinal herbs (chamomile, wormwood, St. John's wort, etc.)
carpathian.hygiene_note: To make your stay as pleasant as possible, we completely change the water in the tub and carry out disinfection after each group of guests.
carpathian.photo_1_alt: Carpathian hot tub with medicinal herbs — winter evening
carpathian.photo_2_alt: Carpathian hot tub beside the wooden sauna

citrus.title: Pine-citrus hot tub
citrus.body: "Pine-citrus Carpathian hot tub": the aromas of pine, orange, lemon and grapefruit deliver a toning effect to your body and give an incomparable burst of energy and good mood.
citrus.hygiene_note: After each group of guests, the water and citrus fruits are completely refreshed and the tub is disinfected. So you always step into cleanliness and freshness.
citrus.photo_1_alt: Couple in the citrus and pine hot tub

tea.title: Water balance
tea.body: During a sauna visit the body loses a great deal of water, so to restore your water balance you can order herbal tea with bagels and honey, or craft kvass of our own production.
tea.honey_intro: Honey has many beneficial properties and is valued not only for its taste but also for its effects on the body. Key benefits:
tea.photo_3_alt: Flower honey from the Glukhoman apiary
tea.photo_4_alt: Honey in a clay pot with bagels

beer.title: Sauna relaxation
beer.body: For those who love to combine sauna relaxation with a delicious dinner, there is an option to order food, cocktails and our own craft beer from our restaurant. Glukhoman sauna — the ideal place for those seeking quality and unforgettable relaxation.
beer.photo_1_alt: Craft beer and smoked meat at the sauna
beer.photo_2_alt: Guests at the sauna over a beer

stone.title: Stone massage.
stone.body: Stone massage benefits through deep muscle relaxation, improved blood circulation, stress reduction and pain relief. It also harmonises the nervous system. It brings a feeling of lightness, harmony and a surge of energy.
stone.certified_note: Certified massage therapist services available by advance booking.
stone.photo_1_alt: Hot stones on the back by candlelight
stone.photo_2_alt: SPA Professional certificates of sauna masters

classic.title: Classic body massage.
classic.body: Classic massage is beneficial for relaxing muscles, relieving pain and stress, improving blood and lymph circulation, and overall wellbeing. It promotes increased skin elasticity, better sleep quality, strengthening of the immune system and recovery of working capacity after physical exertion or injury.
classic.certified_note: Certified massage therapist services available by advance booking.

thai.title: Thai massage
thai.body_p1: Thai massage is an ancient form of therapeutic massage combining elements of stretching, pressure and yoga, while also acting on the body's energy channels. It promotes deep relaxation, improves flexibility, blood circulation and general wellbeing, and helps to relieve muscle tension. The treatment is usually performed on a mat on the floor, with the client remaining in comfortable clothing.
thai.body_p2: «Pahop» (or «pahob») is a type of Thai massage performed with warm herbal pouches. This treatment combines heat therapy, aromatherapy and massage techniques to relax muscles, relieve pain and improve blood circulation. The herbal pouches used during the massage contain a blend of medicinal herbs that are heated before the procedure.
thai.certified_note: Certified massage therapist services available by advance booking.
thai.photo_1_alt: Thai massage — stretching at the sauna

bamboo.title: Massage
bamboo.body: Bamboo broom massage has ancient Eastern roots and originates mainly from China and Japan. Bamboo has long been considered a symbol of strength, flexibility and healing, and its properties have been used in traditional practices for body recovery. Bamboo broom massage delivers benefits including deep muscle relaxation, relief of tension and stress, improved blood and lymph circulation, and anti-cellulite effects. Additionally, it can improve joint mobility, strengthen the skin and contribute to overall physical and emotional wellbeing.
bamboo.certified_note: Certified massage therapist services available by advance booking.
bamboo.photo_1_alt: Bamboo sticks prepared for the treatment

scrub.title: Scrubs at the sauna
scrub.body: A sauna scrub benefits the skin through the combined effects of hot steam and mechanical exfoliation. It deeply cleanses the skin, stimulates blood circulation and removes toxins. The result is skin that is smooth, soft, moisturised and renewed.
scrub.certified_note: Certified massage therapist services available by advance booking.

meta.title: Restaurant "Glukhoman" - European-Ukrainian cuisine
meta.description: A two-storey restaurant in old fairy-tale style with a covered terrace and three summer areas on the water. European-Ukrainian cuisine, craft beer, live music.

intro.title: Two-storey restaurant
intro.body: On the territory of the restaurant and hotel complex "Glukhoman" you will find a two-story restaurant in an old fairy-tale style with a covered terrace and three summer areas on the water, surrounded by fountains and swans.
intro.img_alt_1: Restaurant hall decorated for the holidays

cuisine.title: European and Ukrainian cuisine
cuisine.body: The restaurant "Glukhoman" will meet you with excellent European-Ukrainian cuisine and friendly staff. This is the best place for craft beer lovers. Here you can enjoy beer of our own production.
cuisine.img_alt_1: Craft beer from our own brewery

music.title: Music evenings
music.body: On Friday, Saturday and Sunday, we invite you to musical evenings. Live music performed by our vocalist, musician, frontman of the "Cover Show Disco 90s", member of the "Live Drums" band DANIL REVEKA will mesmerize you with his vocals.
music.qr_img_alt: QR code of the musician's Instagram
music.ig_aria_label: Instagram of the musician DANIL REVEKA - @danilreveka

hall_i.title: A real Ukrainian stove
hall_i.body: The pride of our establishment is a real Ukrainian stove, hand-built from clay and fired bricks. It is located in the center of the hall, and in the cold season we light wood in it. The live fire, the aroma of fragrant wood and the soft warmth emanating from the stove create a unique home-like atmosphere of calm and warmth. Also, the menu from November to March includes dishes cooked in the oven.
hall_i.img_alt_2: Hall with a stove in winter

hall_ii.title: Separate room
hall_ii.body: Cozy atmosphere, ideal for both evening dates and family dinners.
hall_ii.img_alt_3: Cozy hall in a wooden style

hall_iii.title: Pavilion behind the glass
hall_iii.title_italic: in the heart of the hall.
hall_iii.body: The heart of the hall is our spacious, elegantly designed pavilion behind a glass partition. Watching these graceful birds while dining adds a sense of exoticism and tranquility to the atmosphere.
hall_iii.img_alt_1: A peacock in the peacock garden of the Zhar-Bird Hall
hall_iii.img_alt_4: Served table in the hall of Zhar-Ptitsa

hall_iv.eyebrow: Hall - II floor - 25 seats - fireplace + balcony
hall_iv.title: Fireplace, balcony
hall_iv.body: We invite you to our cozy lounge, which perfectly combines modern comfort with a classic relaxation atmosphere. The centerpiece of the interior is a stylish electric fireplace. It instantly adds a sense of warmth and coziness to the space without unnecessary smoke or odor. The combination of a cozy fireplace area and the ability to go out to the balcony makes it a favorite place for our guests at any time of the year.
hall_iv.img_alt_1: Electric fireplace in the hall on the second floor

hall_v.title: VIP lounge with billiards
hall_v.body: Billiards helps you relax, motivates you to have a friendly or business conversation, calms you down and helps you develop your thinking and logic. In our VIP room, you can enjoy the game at any time of the day or night, as well as enjoy unfiltered beer of our own production.
hall_v.img_alt_1: VIP lounge with a 12-foot billiard table
hall_v.img_alt_2: Billiard table with cues and balls

hall_vi.title: Terrace Hall
hall_vi.title_italic: for your holidays and corporate events.
hall_vi.body: The perfect location for anniversaries, corporate parties or large family celebrations. We invite you to enjoy exquisite cuisine and first-class service in an atmosphere of lightness and celebration. The spacious layout makes it easy to transform the space for any event format: from classic banquet seating to a free lounge buffet.
hall_vi.img_alt_1: General view of the Terrace hall
hall_vi.img_alt_4: Logo of Glukhoman on the green wall
hall_vi.img_alt_5: Festive arrangement with balloons for a birthday

hall_vii.title: Banquet hall
hall_vii.body: We invite you to our spacious and luxurious banquet hall, which is ideal for large-scale celebrations. The hall can comfortably accommodate up to 90 guests in a banquet format. The layout allows you to arrange the tables in different ways (U-shaped, round tables or herringbone), with space for a dance floor, stage and a separate area for photo shoots or a buffet table.
hall_vii.img_alt_2: Banquet hall with a long table
hall_vii.img_alt_3: Entrance to the banquet hall with a logo

hall_viii.body: Celebrate your birthday, wedding or corporate event at Glukhoman restaurant and make it unforgettable! Come together with your friends and family to enjoy delicious dishes, refined atmosphere and the best service. You can also order an individual photo zone for your celebration. And our art director DANIL REVEKA will organize musical accompaniment for you (live music, DJ, hostess).
hall_viii.img_alt_2: Photo zone in red and gold colors
hall_viii.img_alt_4: Art director of the restaurant DANIL REVEKA

hall_ix.title: Free
hall_ix.body: For kids, Glukhoman also has something special - a free playroom (on the second floor of the restaurant) with toys, a maze and coloring books. Kids will have fun with our animators. We also have a children's menu and desserts that will delight them with their favorite flavors.

hall_x.title: Quests, animations, shows,
hall_x.body: Our animators conduct various quests, animations, soap shows, cryo shows, laser tag.
hall_x.img_alt_1: An animator in a costume with a child
hall_x.img_alt_3: Laser tag in the open air

story.title: Silence that heals.
story.body_1: We built this hotel as a refuge for those who are tired of the city. The rooms are hidden among the pine trees, the windows open to the forest, and in the morning you are woken up not by an alarm clock, but by the light through the curtains and the chirping of birds.
story.body_2: All materials are natural. All the details are well thought out. And everything you need is waiting for you within a few minutes' walk: a restaurant, a water park, saunas and a lake.

features.nature_text: Pine forest, clean air and silence outside the room.
features.comfort_text: Orthopedic mattresses, linen bedding and everything you need to sleep.
features.cuisine_text: The complex's restaurant serves Ukrainian dishes made from local products.
features.location_text: Convenient access, free parking and shuttle service on request.

heritage.title: A place with a history
heritage.body_1: It all started with an old farmhouse in the middle of a pine forest. Step by step, year by year, Glukhoman has grown from a quiet family project into a full-fledged recreational complex.
heritage.body_2: We have preserved the main thing - the feeling of home, the smell of resin and that special light that only happens in a pine forest in the evening.
heritage.year_2012_text: The complex is founded on the site of an old farmhouse. The first restaurant opens its doors.
heritage.year_2016_text: A hotel with 20 rooms was built. Stables and a walking route around the pond were built along with it.
heritage.year_2019_text: Opening of a water park. The complex becomes a full-fledged recreational place for families.
heritage.year_2023_text: "Glukhoman" becomes one of the best vacation spots in Poltava region, with its own wood-fired bathhouse and brewery.

checkin.map_text: Map of the territory, walking routes and recommendations from the hotel team.
checkin.transfer_text: We will help you with your luggage from the parking lot to your room upon request.

testimonials.title: The voices of our guests.
testimonials.review_1_quote: We returned home and still dream about the sound of water and the noise of pine trees. The Suite with a balcony is a place where you want to come back.
testimonials.review_2_quote: The kids liked the water park, we liked the bathhouse and the quiet in the evening on the terrace by the pond. The family room is spacious, with everything you need.
testimonials.review_3_quote: We came for one night and stayed for three. The restaurant with the Ukrainian oven is a separate story. We will definitely come back.

slides.description: From high-speed downhill runs to calm family routes. Each hill has its own character, length and pace.

slide_1.name: Forest lightning
slide_1.text: A high-speed descent from two parallel tracks. The drop is twelve meters and the time to complete the course is six seconds. For visitors from 140 centimeters in height.

slide_2.name: Black tunnel
slide_2.text: Closed pipe with sharp turns in complete darkness. The "forest cave" scene with lighting and sound. Not for those who are afraid of the unknown.

slide_3.name: Rafting "Rodina"
slide_3.text: A wide slide that can accommodate up to four people at a time. The calm pace and safe trajectory are ideal for the first time the whole family goes down together.

slide_4.name: Children's stream
slide_4.text: A small wavy slide for the youngest ones. It is two meters high and has a soft landing in a shallow pool. An animator is always on duty nearby.

family.img_alt: Family at the entrance to the water park Glukhoman
family.description_p1: The Glukhoman water park is designed so that every member of the family can find their favorite activity: kids splash in safe shallow pools, teenagers try out high-speed slides, and adults relax in the jacuzzi or on shady sun loungers at the bar.
family.description_p2: Our rescuers keep a close eye on all areas, so you can enjoy a sunny day knowing that your children are in safe hands.

includes.description: From a towel to a soft drink, we have taken care of every detail to make your visit comfortable from the first to the last minute.
includes.rule_1_text: Every day from 09:00 to 22:00, seven days a week.
includes.rule_2_text: Children under 12 years of age must be accompanied by an adult.
includes.rule_3_text: Professional rescuers are on duty at all zones at all times.

safety.description: We have created an environment where you can fully trust your vacation. A professional team, strict protocols, and cleanliness that does not require explanation.
safety.card_1_text: Three professional lifeguards per shift. Ministry of Sport certification and regular training.
safety.card_2_text: An on-site nurse, an automatic defibrillator and a full first aid kit are available in case of any emergency.
safety.card_3_text: Chemical analysis every two hours. The automatic filtration and disinfection system operates continuously.
safety.card_4_text: Each slide has clear age and height restrictions. The staff closely monitors compliance.

schedule.kicker: One day at the water park
schedule.description: Every hour has its own mood. This is how a summer day usually passes on the territory of the water park "Glukhoman".
schedule.row_1_d: Cool water, first sunlight through the trees, almost empty slides. Time for those who appreciate silence.
schedule.row_2_d: Animators start activities for children near the children's area - games, contests and water adventures.
schedule.row_3_d: The terrace of the restaurant "Glukhoman" is a three-minute walk away. Summer menu, cold drinks, shady tables.
schedule.row_4_d: The most people, the most laughter. Live music on the summer playground and queues at your favorite slides.
schedule.row_5_d: The crowd is thinning, the water is still warm, and the sun is turning golden. It's the most beautiful hour of the day.
schedule.row_6_d: We return to the hotel "Glukhoman" for a warm shower, dinner, and a long, peaceful sleep in the forest silence.

pricing.description: To ensure that you always receive the latest information about family packages, promotions and group orders, we encourage you to contact us directly. One call and we'll find the best solution for your family.

faq.q1: When is the water park open?
faq.a1: The season lasts from May to September. Check the exact opening date by phone - it depends on the weather.
faq.a2: Yes, we have a separate children's area with shallow pools, small slides and water toys. Safety is guaranteed - professional lifeguards supervise the children.
faq.a3: Yes, you are welcome to bring your baby, but swimming is only allowed in the children's pools. Lockers and high chairs are available upon request.
faq.a4: Professional lifeguards with medical training are constantly on duty at the water park.
faq.q5: What is included in the price?
faq.a5: Entrance to the water park, access to all pools, slides, lockers, showers and recreation areas. Towels are available for a fee or on request.
faq.q6: Is it possible to book a separate area for the celebration?
faq.a6: Yes, we accept group orders for birthdays, corporate events, and other celebrations. Contact us for details.

packing.description: Everything else can be rented or bought on site - towels, hats, cream, and refreshments are waiting at the reception.
packing.item_1_text: A swimsuit or swimming trunks, flip-flops and a swimming cap are required in all sports areas.
packing.item_2_text: SPF 50 sunscreen, a hat or panama hat for shade. The sun in Nyzhni Mlynky is generous.
packing.item_3_text: A towel (or rent one on site) and a bottle of drinking water. The rest will be brought by the bar.
packing.item_4_text: An adult passport and an entrance ticket. You will receive the key to the locker at the reception.

cta.description: Book your visit now and we'll make sure you have the best day by the water.

hero.headline: Menu
hero.intro: Ukrainian and European cuisine inspired by the seasons and local products. Craft beer from our own brewery to match every dish.

philosophy.headline: A taste that remembers
philosophy.para1: Our cuisine is born out of local products: farm meat, Poltava cheeses, vegetables from our own garden, fish from local reservoirs and flour from the old mill.
philosophy.para2: We combine the traditions of Ukrainian cuisine with European techniques and complement everything with craft beer from our own brewery, brewed according to the recipes of the head brewer.

chefPicks.headline: Favorite dishes
chefPicks.description: What guests order most often - and what we recommend trying on their first visit.
chefPicks.dish1Desc: A seasonal hit, the main dish is baked in the oven until golden brown.
chefPicks.dish2Desc: Classics that never leave the menu. Lard, donuts, sour cream.
chefPicks.dish3Desc: Craft beer from the company's own brewery is a winner of a regional festival.
chefPicks.dish4Desc: The most popular dessert is melted honey from our own apiary.

oven.headline: A real oven
oven.para1: At the heart of our kitchen is a real Ukrainian stove, hand-built of clay and brick. We heat it only with wood - no gas, no electricity. It's a slow way to cook, but the only one that gives us the taste we remember from childhood.
oven.para2: Our roasted duck, homemade rye bread, buckwheat porridge in pots, and cherry pies are born in the oven. Dishes that only really sound good when they are touched by a live fire.

section_1.heading: General provisions
section_1.body_p1: This Privacy Policy describes how the recreational complex "Glukhoman" (hereinafter referred to as the "Complex") collects, uses, stores and protects personal data of site visitors and guests. The policy is developed in accordance with the Law of Ukraine "On Personal Data Protection" and other regulations governing the processing of personal data.
section_1.body_p2: By using our website or services, you agree to the terms of this Policy. If you do not agree with any of the terms, please refrain from using the site and submitting personal data.

section_2.heading: What data we collect
section_2.intro: We collect only the data that is necessary to provide our services and communicate with our guests:
section_2.contact_body: name, phone number and e-mail address that you provide through the booking form or when contacting us.
section_2.technical_body: cookies necessary for the correct functioning of the site and saving your settings.
section_2.analytics_body: impersonal statistics of visits if web analytics services are activated on the website.

section_3.heading: How we use the data
section_3.intro: The received personal data is used exclusively for:
section_3.item_1: processing requests for room and service reservations;
section_3.item_2: communication with guests to clarify the details of their stay;
section_3.item_3: sending booking confirmations and service messages;
section_3.item_4: improving the quality of service and website operation.

section_4.heading: Storage and protection
section_4.body_p1: Your personal data is stored for the period necessary to achieve the purposes of its processing or for the period established by the current legislation of Ukraine. We use organizational and technical measures to protect personal data from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure or destruction.
section_4.body_p2: The complex does not transfer personal data to third parties without the consent of the data subject, except in cases expressly provided for by the current legislation of Ukraine.

section_5.heading: User rights
section_5.intro: In accordance with the Law of Ukraine "On Personal Data Protection", you have the right:
section_5.item_1: receive information about the processing of your data;
section_5.item_2: request access to their personal data;
section_5.item_3: request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data;
section_5.item_4: request the deletion of your personal data from our database;
section_5.item_5: file a complaint with the Ukrainian Parliament Commissioner for Human Rights.

section_6.heading: Processing of requests
section_6.subheading: How we respond to your requests
section_6.body: You can contact us in a convenient way regarding the processing of personal data - we strive to respond within a reasonable time and provide comprehensive information regarding your data. Contact channels are listed in the block below.

section_7.heading: Changes to the policy
section_7.body: The Complex reserves the right to update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The new version comes into force from the moment it is published on the website. We recommend that you periodically review this page to be aware of the current conditions.

section_1.heading: General provisions
section_1.body_p1: This document is an official public offer of the recreational complex "Glukhoman" (hereinafter referred to as the "Complex") addressed to any individual or legal entity (hereinafter referred to as the "Guest") to conclude a service agreement on the terms and conditions set forth below.
section_1.body_p2: The fact of acceptance of this offer is the placement of a reservation through the website, telephone or other available communication channels, as well as payment for services. From the moment of acceptance, the contract is considered to be concluded on the terms of this offer.

section_2.heading: Subject of the agreement
section_2.intro: The complex provides the Guest with the following services in accordance with the selected booking option:
section_2.item_2: meals in the restaurant of the Complex;
section_2.item_4: use of the sauna and bath complex;
section_2.item_5: additional services (apitherapy, wedding events, paintball, etc.) according to the current list.

section_3.heading: Booking and payment
section_3.body_p1: Reservations are made through the form on the website, by calling the numbers indicated in the "Contacts" section, or directly at the reception of the Complex. After receiving the application, the administrator contacts the Guest to confirm the booking details.
section_3.body_p2: For a guaranteed reservation, an advance payment may be required in the amount agreed with the Guest at the time of application. Full payment is made within the terms and in the manner agreed upon when confirming the reservation.

section_4.heading: Cancellation and refunds
section_4.body: In case of cancellation of the reservation, the Guest is obliged to notify the administration of the Complex as soon as possible. Refunds are made in accordance with the terms agreed by the parties directly at the time of booking, taking into account the notice period and the nature of the booked services.

section_5.heading: Rules of stay
section_5.intro: The following rules apply to ensure a comfortable stay for all guests of the Complex:
section_5.quiet_body: from 22:00 to 08:00, please refrain from loud conversations and music.
section_5.smoking_body: is allowed only in specially designated areas.
section_5.pets_body: is possible by prior agreement with the administration.
section_5.property_body: Guests are obliged to take care of the property of the Complex and comply with fire safety rules.

section_6.heading: Responsibility of the parties
section_6.body: The parties are responsible for non-fulfillment or improper fulfillment of the terms of this offer in accordance with the current legislation of Ukraine. The Complex is not responsible for damage caused by the Guest as a result of violation of the rules of stay, as well as for the safety of personal belongings left unattended.

section_7.heading: Force majeure
section_7.body: The parties shall be released from liability for partial or complete failure to fulfill obligations if it is the result of force majeure circumstances: natural disasters, military actions, decisions of public authorities, accidents on engineering networks and other events that the parties could not foresee or prevent.

section_8.heading: Final provisions
section_8.body: For all questions related to this offer, please contact the contacts listed in the block below. The Complex reserves the right to make changes to the terms and conditions of this offer; the current version is published on the website and comes into force from the moment of publication.
